faq.q: What does Y2K mean?
faq.a: It is short for the year 2000. People use it for the fashion, gadgets and photo style of roughly the late 1990s and early 2000s.

faq.q: Why do the highlights look blown out?
faq.a: On purpose. Small flashes of that era often overexposed skin and left the background dark, and the look copies that effect together with soft focus and light noise.

faq.q: Will my clothes change?
faq.a: Yes. Outfits, accessories and the hairstyle are restyled to early-2000s fashion, and the surroundings are adapted to match. If you want your own clothes to stay, try the [night out flash](/create/photo-trend-maker/night-flash) look instead.

faq.q: Is this the same as a film look?
faq.a: No. Film looks have warm fading and organic grain, while this one is digital: flash, noise and compression. For film, try the [70s slide portrait](/create/photo-trend-maker/70s-slide).

faq.q: How many credits does a Y2K snapshot cost?
faq.a: One credit per generation, whichever size you pick, and the credit is returned automatically if a generation fails. Each attempt is a new picture, so it is worth trying a second time if the flash looks too harsh or the framing is too tight.

faq.q: Can I use a group photo?
faq.a: Yes, and small groups suit the style well, since casual snapshots of two to four friends were the whole point of those cameras. Faces drift more as the group grows, so crop out anyone who does not need to be in the picture.

seo.description: Turn a photo of you or your pet into a small figure inside a snow globe with drifting flakes, a tiny village and warm Christmas lights. Download a finished JPG.

intro: The snow globe look rebuilds the subject of your photo as a small figure inside a round glass globe. A person gets a cozy winter outfit and a pet gets a little scarf, and they stand in a tiny snowy village with pine trees and a cottage on a decorated base.

The result is composed like a photograph of a real object: soft white flakes drift inside the glass, the glass reflects and bends the light, and warm out-of-focus Christmas lights and a garland glow on a wooden mantel behind it. Upload one photo, pick a size and download a JPG. As with the claymation and felt looks, the picture keeps the spirit of the subject more than every detail of the face.

bestFor.title: Pets and portraits with a clear outline
bestFor.description: A dog, a cat or a person photographed against a simple background turns into a clean figure inside the globe, and the pet keeps its fur color and markings.

bestFor.title: Holiday cards and small gifts
bestFor.description: A snow globe picture works as the image on a digital card, a message to a friend or a small gift for someone who loves their pet.

bestFor.title: Pinterest boards of winter and Christmas ideas
bestFor.description: The 2:3 size matches the shape Pinterest recommends for standard Pins, and the globe fills a tall frame well.

designNotes.title: Pick a photo with one clear subject
designNotes.description: The globe holds a single figure. A sharp photo with the subject large in the frame gives the AI a recognizable figure to place inside the glass.

designNotes.title: Expect a miniature, not a portrait
designNotes.description: Like the [claymation world](/create/photo-trend-maker/claymation) and [felt miniature](/create/photo-trend-maker/felt-miniature) looks, the figure is simplified for the small scene, so it keeps the spirit of the face more than the exact details.

designNotes.title: Only one globe
designNotes.description: The instructions ask for a single snow globe, so a group photo is better cropped to one or two people before you upload it.

designNotes.title: Use a tall size for the whole globe
designNotes.description: The 9:16 and 2:3 sizes leave room for the glass, the base and the glowing lights. The 1:1 size frames the globe more tightly.

tryThese: Photo: a grey tabby cat sitting on a windowsill, size 2:3
Photo: a golden retriever looking at the camera, size 9:16
Photo: a smiling person in a scarf, size 3:4
Photo: a small dog on a sofa, size 1:1

faq.q: Will it look like me or my pet?
faq.a: The instructions keep the subject's identity, colors and expression recognizable, but the figure is small and simplified. Fur color and markings usually survive well. Generate again if a result drifts.

faq.q: Can I make a snow globe of my pet?
faq.a: Yes, and pets are one of the best uses. A pet gets a little scarf and sits in the snowy village. The look is told not to add a person or an animal that is not in your photo.

faq.q: Does the picture contain any text?
faq.a: The instructions ask for no text. AI can still draw stray lettering on a small sign, so look closely before you post it.

faq.q: How is it different from the claymation look?
faq.a: The [claymation world](/create/photo-trend-maker/claymation) rebuilds the whole scene from modelling clay. The snow globe puts a small figure inside glass, with drifting snow, reflections and Christmas lights around it.

seo.title: New Year's Eve Photo Maker – AI Party Flash Portrait
seo.description: Turn a photo into a New Year's Eve party portrait with sparkling black and gold, confetti, sparklers and bright flash. Download a 9:16, 2:3, 3:4 or square JPG.
seo.h1: New Year's Eve Party Photo Maker

intro: The New Year's Eve party look turns a photo into a glamorous party snapshot shot with a bright on-camera flash. The subject wears tasteful sparkling black and gold, with a glittering headband, hat or tiara, in a dim room full of falling gold and silver confetti, streamers, sparklers and a mirror ball that scatters small points of light.

Strong flash highlights, deep shadows and fine film grain give it the candid feel of a magazine party page, and the expression is happy and mid-celebration. The look draws no text, numbers or clocks, so there is no countdown to misspell. Upload a photo, pick a size and download a JPG.

bestFor.title: Selfies and portraits of one or two people
bestFor.description: A close, well-lit photo keeps the likeness best. The outfit, the accessory and the room change while the face stays yours.

bestFor.title: Party posts and group chats
bestFor.description: A flash portrait works as the picture on a party post, a story or the message you send to friends before the night. Write the date and place yourself in the post.

bestFor.title: Pets in party accessories
bestFor.description: A pet stays recognizable with a small party accessory. The look is told not to add a person or an animal that is not in your photo.

designNotes.title: Start with a close, bright photo
designNotes.description: Window light and a face that fills a good part of the frame give the AI the most to hold on to. Dark or distant photos drift further from the original.

designNotes.title: Expect a new outfit
designNotes.description: The look dresses the subject in sparkling black and gold, so the clothes in your photo are replaced. If you want to keep your own outfit, choose a different look.

designNotes.title: Add the year yourself
designNotes.description: Do not expect a year or a countdown on the picture, because the look asks for no text and no numbers. Add them in another app if you want them.

designNotes.title: Compare it with Night Out Flash
designNotes.description: The [night out flash](/create/photo-trend-maker/night-flash) look keeps a dim city mood. This one adds confetti, sparklers, glitter and a mirror ball, so it suits a celebration more than an ordinary night out.

tryThese: Photo: a close selfie with a big smile, size 2:3
Photo: a couple standing close together, size 9:16
Photo: a friend laughing indoors, size 3:4
Photo: a dog looking at the camera, size 1:1

faq.q: Can it write the new year on the picture?
faq.a: No. The instructions ask for no text, numbers or clocks, which also avoids misspelled words. Add the year in a card or messaging app after you download the JPG.

faq.q: How is it different from Night Out Flash?
faq.a: Both use a bright on-camera flash. The [night out flash](/create/photo-trend-maker/night-flash) look keeps the real colors against a moody city background, while this look adds a black and gold party outfit, confetti, sparklers and a mirror ball.

faq.q: Does it work for couples?
faq.a: Yes. One or two people close together keep the likeness best, and the sparkling outfits and accessories are added to both. Large groups tend to drift, so crop the photo to the people who matter.

faq.q: Will it add other people to the party?
faq.a: It is told not to. The scene is filled with confetti, streamers, sparklers and lights, and the people are the ones in your photo. If an extra person or hand appears, generate again.
